message.content: <system-reminder>harness note</system-reminder>How should I merge two ranked result lists?

content.text: Use reciprocal rank fusion: sum 1/(k + rank) per document.
It needs only ranks, so BM25 and cosine scores never have to be compared.

message.content: Why k = 60? My key is sk-ant-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456 by the way.
